note=Distributed (un-patched) blob, deliberately: mixed cells (#address-cells=2,
  #size-cells=1), a zero-size /memory node and no /system linux,revision — the
  firmware patches those at boot, so this fixture is the honest hard case for
  kernel_core::fdt (ADR-0073 §6). A firmware-patched dump captured from the
  Pi 4B is a residual second fixture (next HW session).
